title: Why Fewer Kids Are Playing Team Sports Than Ever
hook: Your kid got benched by life: boys playing sports fell to 41 percent.
closing: Data benched himself in 2013. Never looked back.
question: Did you play sports as a kid?

segments.say: In 2013, half of American boys played a team sport; now just 41 percent do.
Participation among the lowest-income teens has fallen to just 27 percent.
About 1.2 million fewer kids are playing organized team sports than just a few years ago.
